WITH facility_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        f.fackey,
        -- TAR
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN to2.txadh IN ('High', 'Medium') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) 
            / NULLIF(COUNT(to2.txoutkey), 0) as tar,
        -- CIF and MAR components
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.patkey) as patient_count,
        SUM(tb.crisisint) as total_crisisint,
        SUM(e.missappt) as total_missappt
    FROM facilities f
    JOIN clinicians c ON c.facconnect = f.fackey
    JOIN patients p ON p.clinleadref = c.clinkey
    JOIN encounters e ON e.patref = p.patkey
    LEFT JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.encref = e.enckey
    LEFT JOIN treatmentoutcomes to2 ON to2.txref = tb.txkey
    GROUP BY f.fackey
),

    SELECT 
        fackey,
        tar,
        CASE WHEN patient_count > 0 THEN total_crisisint / patient_count ELSE NULL END as cif,
        CASE WHEN patient_count > 0 THEN total_missappt / patient_count ELSE NULL END as mar,
        CASE WHEN patient_count > 0 THEN 1.0 / (1.0 + total_crisisint / patient_count + total_missappt / patient_count) ELSE NULL END as psm
    FROM facility_metrics
),
median_vals AS (
    SELECT 
    (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tar) FROM facility_scores WHERE tar IS NOT NULL) as median_tar,
    (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY psm) FROM facility_scores WHERE psm IS NOT NULL) as median_psm

        WHEN fs.tar < mv.median_tar AND fs.psm >= mv.median_psm THEN 'Low Adherence, High Stability'
        ELSE 'Low Adherence, Low Stability'
    END as performance_quadrant
FROM facility_scores fs, median_vals mv
